requestVerdicts.reason: The request asks for the twelve pairs to be re-rendered front-on because the p71 sheet draws them as bonded three-quarter product views. The corrected front-facing twelve-pair source is already here: shoes.png at 4336x5804, classified CORRECTED_REPLACEMENT by the sweep, deterministically chopped into twelve candidates that hash exactly as recorded. What remains is the ordinary fit, anchor and human-acceptance gate on art the project owns, which is not a generation.

Seven adult morphologies are now banked as fifty-one morphology-reference components, so the request may no longer say the standing body family is a single green-edged sheet. It is still required: every one of the hundred and eleven components reports eligibleAsProductionCharacterBody false, because each source cell sits under the standing floor of 1696x2528, and the pipeline never enlarges a raster.

Nineteen seated poses are banked across seven adult morphologies, so the request may no longer say seated-at-a-desk is uncovered in the bank. Ten of those nineteen carry baked furniture, four a chair and six a desk. Separately, seventeen components of any pose carry a baked interaction prop: five a lectern, four a chair and eight a desk. Every one of them is under the seated floor of 1530x2048 and reports eligibleAsProductionCharacterBody false, so they are interaction reference rather than a seated production body.

IMG_5192.PNG is in the repository now rather than only in Drive, and it shows the green contour fix is achievable in this art family. It does not close the request: at 5056x3392 it is the same sheet resolution, so a clean re-export at that size still fails the body floor. The re-export has to be a re-export at production resolution.

The request said no cell stands at a lectern or rests its hands on a raised surface. Five preserved components carry a baked lectern and are cited here one by one: the fat-man and additional-fat-female lectern-interaction cells, the average-man and older-woman interaction-surface cells, and the skinny-man standing_neutral_back cell, which the review classifies LECTERN and which an earlier reading of this evidence left out. It is still required, because all five carry the lectern baked into the figure and sit under the production floor, so they are reference for the pose rather than modular art that composes into a scene.
Every preserved morphology is adult. Nothing in the ingested cargo is a child or adolescent body, and a scaled adult is the failure this request exists to avoid.

The request recorded that the only file above the 4608 environment floor was the rejected photoreal variant. That is no longer true: IMG_5189.JPG, an executive-office candidate at 5504x3072, is in the repository and clears the floor on width. It does not close the request. Clearing a dimension floor is not acceptance: its style has not been judged against the accepted rendering language, no environment intake has been run on it, and it is not promoted here. It is assessed before anything new is commissioned for this room.

Three preserved candidates bear on this room, and the request may no longer say nothing resembling a campaign space is banked. IMG_5190.JPG and IMG_5207.JPG are different JPEG bytes that decode to identical pixels: one picture, encoded twice, not two variants. Both carry the baked readable text this request forbids, a FIELD OFFICE window sign and supplies printed on two boxes. IMG_5205.JPG is a third candidate and a different room: a storefront in use as a phone bank, 5504x3072, folding tables, mismatched chairs, desk phones, stacked boxes with blank labels, a blank corkboard and a blank whiteboard, empty of people, with no readable text found on inspection. It answers the recipe and it is not withdrawn on that basis, because a candidate raster clearing the written criteria is not acceptance: IMG_5205.JPG has never been through npm run intake:environment, carries no declared source lineage, has not been judged against the accepted shared-workroom rendering language, and has no human acceptance. That assessment, not a generation, is the remaining blocker; no new storefront may be commissioned until IMG_5205.JPG has been assessed and rejected.
A foreground mask is cut from the plate it belongs to. Nothing preserved is the committee hearing room plate, so no ingested file can supply another room's near seating.

The preserved packet contains no generic exterior doorstep or stoop. Existing apartment interiors, the park pavilion, the campaign storefront and meeting rooms answer different environment classes and cannot substitute for this threshold scene. The separate private Art Desk attempt remains unapproved and is not evidence in this reconciliation.

The preserved packet contains the warm-leaf parent pavilion only. It contains no same-geometry leafless winter variant, and the separate private Art Desk attempt remains unapproved and is not evidence in this reconciliation.

The preserved packet is exactly what this request is about. Ten of the nineteen banked seated poses carry baked furniture, four of them a chair, and seventeen components of any pose carry a baked interaction prop. So the ask may not say a seated body free of furniture is simply missing: what exists is seated art with the chair painted into it. It is still required, and deliberately worded as the requirement rather than the repair, because a seated body with no furniture attached is reachable either by drawing a new one or by separating the chair out of these; every one of them is under the seated floor of 1530x2048 and reports eligibleAsProductionCharacterBody false, and the pipeline never enlarges a raster.
